first_reader_said: EZR 2:36: Both records hold the priestly family head Jedaiah of the house of Jeshua in this list.
NEH 7:39: Both records are the priestly house of Jedaiah 'of the house of Jeshua' in the return list; A already cites NEH 7:39.

why: EZR 2:36 and NEH 7:39 give the identical priestly family entry in both records, supporting duplication there. However, NEH 12:6 and NEH 12:7 list two distinct Jedaiahs, both currently assigned to A, so A already combines different people. The supplied text does not identify which Jedaiah corresponds to B’s family head, and “of the house of Jeshua” does not establish descent from the ninth-course priest.
